question: For what purpose is this twofold being said to be born as two-footed or four-footed for one to seven births?
premises: Thus this being passes through births from one up to seven.
That being is twofold, either two-footed or four-footed.
Such a being is born as an animal for the purpose of an oblation to a goddess.
inference: A being who falls into this cycle is born twofold as two-footed or four-footed for one to seven births as an animal for a goddess oblation.
uncertainties: It is unclear whether the count is fixed to seven or extends up to seven.
The relation between the twofold form and the cycle of births remains open.
plain_english: Thus this being, twofold as two-footed or four-footed, is born for one to seven births as an animal for the purpose of an oblation to a goddess.
